newsitem.title: USA: FAA probes Tennessee skydivers' plane crash.
newsitem.headline: FAA probes Tennessee skydivers' plane crash.

text.p: Investigators from the Federal Aviation Administration Sunday were probing the cause of a plane crash that hospitalized six skydivers and their pilot.

The twin-engine Beechcraft Bonanza crashed Saturday on takeoff less than a mile from the Tullahoma Regional Airport, cutting a 30-foot swath through a wooded area, according to officials at the scene.
One skydiver, Robert Stewart, of Chattanooga, said the craft's left engine cut out about 75 to 100 feet off the ground.
Russ Haynes of the Tennessee Emergency Management Agency said the plane was owned by the Tennessee Skydiving Center.
